parameter.name: path
parameter.description: Path to write to, relative to the connection's working directory

parameter.name: writeBlock
parameter.description: Size of one write block, which is this stage's unit of work. Defaults to 8MB. 8MB suits local disk and a LAN share; a high-latency mount wants more.

parameter.name: writeBlockUnit
parameter.description: Unit for writeBlock: B, KB, MB or GB. Defaults to B, so a bare writeBlock is a plain byte count.

parameter.name: checkpointFrequency
parameter.description: Write blocks between checkpoints, default 1. At most this many blocks are re-written after a failure. The bytes go to a part file nothing can see until the transfer commits, so raising it costs only bandwidth on a resume and buys one fewer flush per block.
